hover-fill.$description: Colour B (2026-10-04): hover fill = the ground. Visible on cards; on the ground itself use a border or underline instead.

icon-muted.$description: Colour B (2026-10-04): muted icons and non-text marks, 3:1. Never text on light.

background.$description: Light page ground: cool.25 #f6f7f9 (colour B, 2026-10-04, Elleta; was pure white).

dont: Not a surface, card or chip fill

background-inverse.$description: Inverse dark section on a light page.

usage: full-bleed dark sections embedded in a light layout

surface.$description: Raised card surface on ground. Cards separate from the page by lift and warmth, not darkness.

surface-card.$description: Card fill: white cool.0 on the cool ground, hairline edge (colour B, 2026-10-04, Elleta; was panel #f2f2f2 on white).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): text-primary 16.13:1, text-secondary 8.53:1 (AAA). Card vs ground 1.07:1, so the hairline edge carries the shape.

surface-elevated.$description: Highest light surface. Same value as surface, light-mode elevation is shadow-borne (portfolio contract); dark mode steps values instead.

surface-inset.$description: Recessed surface on ground, wells, tracks, inset panels.

ground.$description: The page ground under raised cards (colour B, 2026-10-04, Elleta): the same step as background, cool.25 #f6f7f9. Raised cards are white above it; inset (cool.50) sits one step below it. Added 2026-10-03 for the portfolio layout.

usage: The page behind raised cards in a three-level layout
Not the default page: that stays background
dont: Do not put muted text on ground in warm: 6.72:1 is AA, not AAA (light, colour B: 7.95:1, AAA); put meta on raised, or use ink
Do not use it for strokes: that is border

raised.$description: A raised card on the ground (colour B, 2026-10-04, Elleta): white, the same step as surface-card, so cards never read as holes. Added 2026-10-03.

usage: Cards and panels that sit on ground
dont: Do not put it on the plain page background in light: both are white there

surface-inverse.$description: Raised surface inside dark embedded blocks on light pages.

surface-glass.$description: Primary glass surface. Ground shows through the warm white. Pair with border-glass-top, shadow.raised, and blur.surface.

a11y.contextRequirement: Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only. Do not stack glass over saturated fills.
Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only.

surface-glass-light.$description: Lightest glass. Subtle secondary panels and nested containers.

a11y.contextRequirement: Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only.

surface-glass-accent.$description: Ochre-tinted glass: active or selected state only.

a11y.contextRequirement: State backgrounds only, never a default surface. Text on it: ink.

border-glass-top.$description: Top highlight on a frosted panel, mimics natural light on glass.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 15.05:1 on the ground (worst), 16.13:1 on card, 13.90:1 on inset. AAA.
Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 7.95:1 on the ground, 8.53:1 on card, 7.34:1 on inset (worst). AAA.
Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 7.95:1 on the ground, 8.53:1 on card, 7.34:1 on inset (worst). AAA. Same value as text-secondary: one muted step.

text-inverse.$description: Text on dark surfaces inside light pages.

usage: headings and body inside embedded dark sections

text-accent.$description: Accent text is ink (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta): ochre is never text on light, and links are ink with an underline.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: same as text-primary.

accent.$description: The accent (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta): ochre, a fill, always with ink text (text-on-accent).

dont: Never text, hairline or stroke on light surfaces (2.08:1 on white)
Never the only signal of a state
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): ink on ochre 7.76:1.
Verified 2026-07-21: ground label on this 7.09:1, AAA.

text-on-accent.$description: Text on ochre fills, both themes: #121212 (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 7.76:1 on ochre.

accent-subtle.$description: Neutral selected wash = inset (colour B, 2026-10-04, Elleta). Never cool.25: that is the hover fill, and selected must differ from hover. Always paired with a non-colour marker (check or edge).

accent-border.$description: Control-weight edge for a selected item (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

dont: Never an input or control border: use border-strong

border-subtle.$description: Hairline divider, decorative only (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

border-faint.$description: Hairline card edge, decorative only (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

dont: Never the sole boundary of an interactive control

border-strong.$description: Control border, 3:1: inputs, selects and controls (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 3.16:1 on the ground (worst), 3.39:1 on card. Non-text AA.

border-ink.$description: 1px ink stroke: diagram frames, the pressed chip, ink rules (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

scrim.$description: Ink at 22%: the scrim behind a modal panel (Drawer). It darkens the page without hiding it.

dont: Not a surface or a text colour

focus-ring.$description: Focus ring (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta): 3px, 3px offset. ochre-deep in light. Means focus only, never decoration at rest.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 3.34:1 on the ground, 3.59:1 on card, 3.09:1 on inset (worst). Non-text AA.
dont: Never at rest: the ring means focus only

danger-text.$description: Error message text (status tokens, brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-04 (colour B): 5.66:1 worst (on danger-subtle), 6.10:1 on the ground. AA text.

danger-subtle.$description: Error wash (status tokens, brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

success-border.$description: Success border and icon (status tokens, brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

success-subtle.$description: Success wash (status tokens, brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

chip-1.$description: Soft tiger-blue chip fill (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

chip-text.$description: Text on chip fills (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

link.$description: Links are ink with an underline (brand refresh, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

dont: Do not color-only distinguish links — always pair with underline
